releases.notes:
## Features

- Force enable certain particle effects under specific circumstances (d55d55f)
- Update the spell and texture registry (7fc8d54)
- Improve the spell effect texture mapper debugging utility (f4f2441)
- Add the spell effect texture mapper debugging utility (71c4343)
- Add debug logging and commands (ae75242)
- Add commands for most wheel menu features (2848355)
- Improve spell effect hiding (57ca7bc)
- Improve spell effects hiding (097ec80)
- Improve the ability tree scanner (c3a439d)
- Add support for text display entities for hiding spell effects (4fb69ed)
- Add more aliases for world events (b5acc2f)
- Change the order of options for the world event sharing menu (10ff9fa)

## Fixes

- Fix certain particles not getting force enabled (31870b7)
- Fix some bugs (df4464e)
- Fix Wynnable causing the game failing to start (d5a26ef)
- Force certain spell effects to show when in specific raid boss rooms (a7cefe2)

## Performance

- Optimize the image assets (dc4b288)
- Improve the performance when disabling spell effects (3c769af, e0bbcf3)

## Uncategorized

- Update the icon (e92f653)
